protocol.author: ChatGPT Pro
protocol.heldout_policy: Evaluate six heldout combinations only after all three primary and replay trajectories have finished
protocol.length_cue_limit: Legal Q length and address count can reveal the target width without independently recognizing UP semantics
protocol.offline_evaluation: After all training and replay, load the six fixed checkpoints per seed and evaluate all 18 rows; final metrics reuse epoch 128
protocol.scope: Protocol-response fitting and seen-address/seen-width combination holdout; not ordinary-frame discrimination, invalid-frame rejection, path grounding, semantic upgrade, continual profile state, growth benefit, or ritual benefit
protocol.stop: Exactly 128 epochs for every seed; no score-based stopping, extension, seed selection, or parameter change
protocol.strong_gate: Every seed has final train 12/12 and heldout 6/6 exact autonomous generation including STOP
protocol.student_interface: Only raw Q plus current answer prefix; only 0/1/STOP targets; no parser results, address, width, length, or profile features
protocol.task: Legal UR1 frame to address plus one UP plus model STOP
protocol.teacher_state: Each row uses an independent valid pre-event tree snapshot with only its target branch n=m-1; no live receiver is run over shuffled widths
